content_action_boundary_record.action_surface: Draft placeholder: begin with no live-service, export, communication, or approval route beyond individually listed operations.

content_action_boundary_record.validation_and_observations: Draft placeholder: keep proposal, validation decision, authorization decision, dispatch, response, and authoritative effect distinct.

data_handling_audit_record.consequential_event_audit: Draft placeholder: populate only when a consequential operation is proposed; use actor, action, target, time, candidate/run identity, policy/approval references, non-content binding, and result without raw hidden reasoning.
data_handling_audit_record.privacy_harm_handoffs: Draft placeholder: record plausible privacy/disparate-impact pathways, affected groups, uncertainty, and accountable-owner or specialized-assessment handoffs.

For implementation work, preserve failed trials, run an end-to-end safe-fixture test, clean up unique artifacts, run the full retest, then perform package/export review.
